text.en:
Subsection nine, Section nineteen, Article VIII of Presidential Decree Numbered Eight hundred
seven is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(9) Those who acquired civil service eligibility by virtue of having passed civil service examinations or
having obtained their equivalents may avail of said eligibilities at any time during their lifetime."
